app.intro: This browser can serve AI requests for your SplitCortex pool, like a phone running the node app.
app.keepOpen: Keep this tab open while the node should serve. A browser may pause hidden tabs, and there is no background service on the web.
app.unsupported: This browser cannot store models (it needs the Origin Private File System and web workers). Use a current Chrome, Edge or Safari.
app.noWebGpu: This browser has no WebGPU, so models can only run on the CPU, which is slow. Use a current Chrome or Edge for the GPU.

join.title: Join a pool
join.intro: Open the pool in the SplitCortex web app, choose Add web node, and the code is filled in here. You can also type the code it shows.

scanErrors.camera: The camera could not be used. Allow camera access for this page, or type the code.

errors.invalidCode: This code is not valid, has expired or was already used. Create a new one in the web app.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.conflict: This browser is already registered. Remove the old device in the web app, or leave the pool here first.
errors.untrustedServer: The server could not prove that it knows the code. Nothing was sent. Check the address of this page.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.server: The server answered with an error. Try again.

node.title: This browser
node.leaveBody: This browser forgets its identity and deletes the stored model. Remove the device in the web app as well, then join again with a new code to use it again.
node.notApproved: Waiting for an admin to approve this device in the web app.
node.noGateway: The platform has not given this device a gateway yet.
node.modelFailed: The model could not be loaded: {{error}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.computeHint: Automatic measures CPU and GPU once per model and takes the faster. An admin's setting in the web app wins.
settings.contextHint: {{min}} to {{max}}; empty is automatic. The model reloads when it changes.
settings.contextInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} or leave empty.
settings.keepScreenOn: Keep the screen on while serving
settings.connectOnStart: Connect and load the model when this page opens

logs.title: Logs
logs.empty: Nothing yet. Logs show states and counts, never prompts or answers.

consent.title: Cookies and analytics
consent.body: We would like to use Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are used. It sets cookies and only starts if you accept. We never send what you type, prompts or answers, keys or codes. You can change your mind any time under Cookie settings in the menu.
